newsitem.title: USA: Globalstar L.P. sells $325 mln 144a snr notes.
newsitem.headline: Globalstar L.P. sells $325 mln 144a snr notes.

text.p: The following debt issue from Globalstar L.P was priced on Tuesday in the 144A private placement market via Bear Stearns & Co Inc, according to a syndicate source.
The offering was increased to $325 million from an original size of $200 million, according to a market source.
